A '''Force drain''' makes your opponent lose Force. During your [[Phase#Control phase|control phase]], you may initiate a drain at a location you control. Announce and resolve each drain before starting the next.<ref name="rb20">[[Media:Decipher Rulebook 2.0.pdf|Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0]], Decipher (November 1998), pp. 4–5. [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Wiki transcription]].</ref>

The base drain is the number of your opponent's Force icons at that location. You can initiate a drain for zero if the opponent has no icons there. Card effects can increase or decrease the amount. Your cards with ability at the location participate, and each can participate in only one drain per turn.<ref name="gl20">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0]], Decipher (November 1998), pp. 61 and 109. [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Wiki transcription]].</ref>

For each Force lost, the opponent chooses a card from their hand or [[Life Force]] and places it face up on the Lost Pile. A permitted [[React|react]] that brings the opponent's presence to the location cancels the drain under the normal rules.<ref name="rb20" /><ref name="gl20" />

Force icons affect both Force generation and the base drain. A card that changes only the Force drain or only Force generation changes that amount alone.<ref name="gl20" />
